name: Block port
description: A pin of this circuit when another project uses it as a block (Place > Block). Ports with the same name are connected, like net labels; the side says where the pin goes on the block's symbol

parameters.name: name
parameters.label: Port name
parameters.description: Name of the block's pin (IN, OUT, VCC...); ports with the same name are connected

parameters.name: side
parameters.label: Side
parameters.description: Side of the block's symbol where this pin goes; pins on a side follow the ports' order on the schematic
